method: Eleven batches of 50 Japanese definitions plus final batch of 33. Each canonical definition and all six localized meanings were actually displayed/read and semantically compared. No structural loop counted as semantic review.
notes: This completes AI reading of glossary meanings only, across 262 lessons and 12 guides.
It does not certify all lesson/guide prose, question banks or native/domain review.
No duplicate field proposals from the locked supplementary 26 are included.
All source evidence, sourceHash and exact before values were checked against raw canonical/translation JSON.
No runtime or raw translation files were edited.
